description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterDefaultConfigHandler, which implements a method to register a default configuration handler in the Smarty templating engine. It includes a single method 'registerDefaultConfigHandler' that validates and sets a callback function for handling default configuration.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterDefaultConfigHandler
classes.description: Defines a method to register a default configuration handler in Smarty templates, managing the callback function and ensuring it is callable.

methods.name: registerDefaultConfigHandler
methods.description: Registers a default configuration handler callback for Smarty templates, validating the callback and assigning it to Smarty's default_config_handler_func.
